source.buildspec:
version: 0.2

env:
  variables:
    AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: "us-east-1"

phases:
  install:
    commands:
      - yum install -y git 2>/dev/null || apt-get install -y git 2>/dev/null || true

  pre_build:
    commands:
      - echo "Cloning $REPO_URL..."
      - git clone $REPO_URL /tmp/repo
      - cd /tmp/repo

  build:
    commands:
      - cd /tmp/repo
      - BUCKET_NAME=kayo-proj-$PROJECT_ID
      - echo "Building project..."
      - |
        if [ -f package.json ]; then
          npm install
          npm run build 2>/dev/null || true
          if [ -d build ]; then BUILD_DIR=build
          elif [ -d dist ]; then BUILD_DIR=dist
          elif [ -d out ]; then BUILD_DIR=out
          elif [ -d public ]; then BUILD_DIR=public
          else BUILD_DIR=.
          fi
        elif [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
          BUILD_DIR=.
        else
          BUILD_DIR=.
        fi
        echo "BUILD_DIR=$BUILD_DIR" > /tmp/build_dir.txt
      - echo "Build complete"

  post_build:
    commands:
      - BUILD_DIR=$(cat /tmp/build_dir.txt | cut -d= -f2)
      - BUCKET_NAME=kayo-proj-$PROJECT_ID
      - cd /tmp/repo
      - echo "Creating S3 bucket $BUCKET_NAME..."
      - aws s3 mb s3://$BUCKET_NAME --region $AWS_DEFAULT_REGION 2>/dev/null || true
      - aws s3api put-bucket-ownership-controls --bucket $BUCKET_NAME --ownership-controls Rules=[{ObjectOwnership=BucketOwnerPreferred}] --region $AWS_DEFAULT_REGION 2>/dev/null || true
      - aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket $BUCKET_NAME --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=false,IgnorePublicAcls=false,BlockPublicPolicy=false,RestrictPublicBuckets=false --region $AWS_DEFAULT_REGION
      - aws s3api put-bucket-website --bucket $BUCKET_NAME --website-configuration '{"IndexDocument":{"Suffix":"index.html"},"ErrorDocument":{"Key":"index.html"}}' --region $AWS_DEFAULT_REGION
      - python3 -c "import json; print(json.dumps({'Version':'2012-10-17','Statement':[{'Sid':'PublicRead','Effect':'Allow','Principal':'*','Action':'s3:GetObject','Resource':'arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET/*'}]}).replace('BUCKET','$BUCKET_NAME'))" > /tmp/policy.json
      - aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket $BUCKET_NAME --policy file:///tmp/policy.json --region $AWS_DEFAULT_REGION
      - echo "Uploading files from $BUILD_DIR..."
      - aws s3 sync $BUILD_DIR s3://$BUCKET_NAME --delete --region $AWS_DEFAULT_REGION
      - APP_URL=http://$BUCKET_NAME.s3-website-$AWS_DEFAULT_REGION.amazonaws.com
      - echo "Deployed to $APP_URL"
      - if [ -n "$CALLBACK_URL" ] && [ -n "$APP_URL" ]; then curl -s -X POST "$CALLBACK_URL" -H "Content-Type:application/json" -d "{\"status\":\"active\",\"app_url\":\"$APP_URL\"}" || true; fi
